endorsements.name: Andrew King
endorsements.label: Detecting Reflective Injection
endorsements.description: This talk will focus on detecting reflective injection with some mildly humorous notes and bypassing said protections until vendors start actually working on this problem. It seems amazing that reflective injection still works. Why is that? Because programmers are lazy. They don't want to write new engines, they want to write definitions for an engine that already exists. So what do we do about it? Release a $5 tool that does what $50 AV has failed epically at for several years now...oh and it took me a week or so...Alternately, you could license it to vendors since their programmers are lazy.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 20
